children: D-Wave Quantum appointed Bernard Gavgani as an independent Class II director, effective September 18, 2026, and he will serve on the Board's Cybersecurity Committee.
Independent Class II Director; member, Cybersecurity Committee

Senior Advisor for Technology & Innovation to BNP Paribas Group Exec Management; former Group CIO (Oct 2018–Jun 2025) and COO for IT & Operations (2009–2018) at BNP Paribas; experience in tech strategy, AI governance, cybersecurity; Advanced Certificate for Executives, MIT Sloan; Executive MBA, HEC Paris.
